player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id}. Yu wokim FifteenPuzzle gem.
Wok bilong gem em long sanapim ol namba tile i go up long nambari 1 go 15, na spes em i stap long kona daun long sait.
Long mekim wanpela move, yu ken surikim wanpela tile i go insait long spes (olsem wanpela dubal underscore, olsem __) long usim wanpela long dispela komand:
- 'up': Surikim tile i stap daun long spes i go antap.
- 'down': Surikim tile i stap antap long spes i go daun.
- 'left': Surikim tile i stap long sait long spes i go kais.
- 'right': Surikim tile i stap long kais long spes i go sait.
Long salim yu move, typim direkshen (olsem 'up', 'down', 'left', o 'right') insait long skwea brekis, olsem [up].
Kasal bilong boda em i soim daun. Usim dispela infomesen long solvim puzzle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I no orait long dispela pasin. Man i pilai {player_id} em i no bekim stret na makim rot bilong en insait long brackets.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Tok i no stret. Dispela tiles em i no inap long go insait long dispela sait yu makim pinis.

outcome.win: Kongratulesen! Player {player_id} i solvim 15-Puzzle i stret.
outcome.turn_limit: Taim bilong wok i pinis. Model i wokim {percent} pesen bilong puzul
